title: Student Privacy & Campus Surveillance Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk from campus surveillance, proctoring software, and school monitoring. Get actionable tips to protect your student data.
description: Assess your exposure to campus surveillance and digital monitoring with our comprehensive privacy risk calculator. Understand how proctoring software, school devices, and campus systems may be collecting your data and get personalized recommendations.

formula: const deviceRisk = deviceUsage === 'school-primary' ? 25 : deviceUsage === 'mixed-usage' ? 15 : deviceUsage === 'personal-only' ? 5 : 0; const proctoringRisk = proctoringFrequency === 'always' ? 30 : proctoringFrequency === 'frequently' ? 25 : proctoringFrequency === 'sometimes' ? 15 : proctoringFrequency === 'rarely' ? 8 : 0; const schoolRisk = schoolType === 'k12-public' ? 15 : schoolType === 'k12-private' ? 10 : schoolType === 'public-university' ? 12 : 8; const networkRisk = Math.round(campusWifiUsage * 0.2); const serviceRisk = Math.min(onlineServices * 2, 20); const awarenessBonus = privacyAwareness === 'all' ? -10 : privacyAwareness === 'most' ? -5 : privacyAwareness === 'some' ? -2 : 0; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, deviceRisk + proctoringRisk + schoolRisk + networkRisk + serviceRisk + awarenessBonus)); const riskLevel = riskScore >= 70 ? 'High Risk' : riskScore >= 40 ? 'Moderate Risk' : riskScore >= 20 ? 'Low-Moderate Risk' : 'Low Risk'; const dataExposure = Math.round(3 + (onlineServices * 1.5) + (proctoringRisk/5) + (deviceRisk/5)); return { riskScore, riskLevel, dataExposure };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates privacy risks based on institutional surveillance capabilities, device monitoring potential, digital proctoring exposure, network usage patterns, and privacy awareness levels. The scoring system weights high-risk factors like comprehensive proctoring and school-issued devices more heavily.
tips: Use Incognito Browser or privacy-focused browsers when possible to limit tracking
Review FERPA rights and understand what educational data can be collected about you
Consider using a VPN when on campus networks to protect browsing activity
Ask about proctoring software permissions and opt for less invasive alternatives when available
Regularly review privacy settings on all educational technology platforms you use
